# netcup_task (Data Source)

One task of the netcup SCP (SCP REST API). `netcup_tasks` lists them.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netcup_task" "example" {
  uuid = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `uuid` (String) UUID of the task.

### Read-Only

- `executing_user` (Attributes) User who started it. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--executing_user))
- `finished_at` (String) End of the task.
- `message` (String) Message of the task.
- `name` (String) Name of the task.
- `on_rollback` (Boolean) Whether the task is rolling back.
- `response_error` (Attributes) Error of a failed task. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--response_error))
- `result` (String) Result of the task as JSON.
- `started_at` (String) Start of the task.
- `state` (String) `PENDING`, `RUNNING`, `FINISHED`, `ERROR`, `WAITING_FOR_CANCEL`, `CANCELED` or `ROLLBACK`.
- `steps` (Attributes List) Steps of the task. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--steps))
- `task_progress` (Attributes) Progress of the task. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--task_progress))

<a id="nestedatt--executing_user"></a>
### Nested Schema for `executing_user`

Read-Only:

- `company` (String) Company.
- `email` (String) E-mail address.
- `firstname` (String) First name.
- `id` (Number) Id of the user.
- `lastname` (String) Last name.
- `username` (String) User name.


<a id="nestedatt--response_error"></a>
### Nested Schema for `response_error`

Read-Only:

- `code` (String) Code of the error.
- `message` (String) Message of the error.


<a id="nestedatt--steps"></a>
### Nested Schema for `steps`

Read-Only:

- `finished_at` (String) End of the step.
- `name` (String) Name of the step.
- `started_at` (String) Start of the step.
- `state` (String) State of the step.
- `uuid` (String) UUID of the step.


<a id="nestedatt--task_progress"></a>
### Nested Schema for `task_progress`

Read-Only:

- `expected_finished_at` (String) Expected end of the task.
- `progress_in_percent` (Number) Progress in percent.
